description_en: Modifies the automatic backup policy for a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 修改PolarDB集群的自动备份策略
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters in a specified region, including the cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The time window for automatic backups. Specify the time in UTC and in the `hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ` format. The time window must be a one-hour period that starts on the hour. For example, `14:00Z-15:00Z`
parameters.help_zh: 执行自动备份的时间段，格式为`hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ`（UTC时间），且输入的数值必须为间隔1个小时的整点，如`14:00Z-15:00Z`。
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday

* You must select at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas.

- This parameter is not supported if your PolarDB for MySQL cluster is in a region that supports the cross-region backup feature. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html.

- After you enable advanced backup, this parameter is no longer effective. Use the `AdvancedDataPolicies` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期，取值范围如下： 
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

* 至少需要选择2天，多个值之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
The retention period for level-1 backups, in days. Valid values: 3 to 14.

After you enable advanced backup, this parameter is no longer effective. Use the `AdvancedDataPolicies` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
一级备份保留周期，取值范围为3~14，单位为天。

开启高级备份后，该字段不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.name: data_level_1_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of level-2 backups. Valid values:

0: Disables the level-2 backup feature.

30 to 7300: The retention period of level-2 backups, in days.

-1: Level-2 backups are permanently retained.

* When you create a cluster, the default value is 0, which disables the level-2 backup feature.

- After you enable advanced backup, this parameter is no longer effective. Use the `AdvancedDataPolicies` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
二级备份保留周期，取值范围如下：

0：关闭二级备份功能。

30～7300：二级备份保留周期，单位为天。

-1：二级备份长期保留。

* 创建集群时，默认取值为0，即关闭二级备份功能。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.name: data_level_2_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain backups when you delete the cluster. Valid values:

ALL: Permanently retains all backups.

LATEST: Permanently retains the last backup.

NONE: Does not retain backup sets.

The default value is `NONE`
parameters.help_zh:
删除集群时是否保留备份：

ALL：长期保留全部备份。

LATEST：长期保留最后一个备份。

NONE：不保留备份集。

默认取值为NONE
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

parameters.help_en:
The backup frequency. Valid values:

Normal (default): standard backup. The cluster is backed up once a day.

2/24H: high-frequency backup. The cluster is backed up every 2 hours.

3/24H: high-frequency backup. The cluster is backed up every 3 hours.

4/24H: high-frequency backup. The cluster is backed up every 4 hours.

* If you enable high-frequency backup, all backups completed within the last 24 hours are retained. For backups older than 24 hours, the system retains only the first backup completed after 00:00 each day and deletes the rest.

- If you enable high-frequency backup, the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter is automatically set to all days of the week (from Monday to Sunday).

- This parameter is not supported if your PolarDB for MySQL cluster is in a region that supports the cross-region backup feature. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html.

- After you enable advanced backup, this parameter is no longer effective. Use the `AdvancedDataPolicies` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
备份频率，取值如下：

Normal（默认）：常规备份，每天定时备份一次。
2/24H：高频备份，每2小时备份一次。
3/24H：高频备份，每3小时备份一次。
4/24H：高频备份，每4小时备份一次。

* 开启高频备份后，备份完成时间在24小时内的备份会全部保留。超过24小时的，系统将仅保留每日00:00点后完成的第一个备份，其他均被删除。
* 开启高频备份后，备份周期PreferredBackupPeriod参数会默认选择一周内的所有天数（即从周一至周日）。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

二级备份跨地域备份区域。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html。
开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of cross-region level-2 backups. Valid values:

0: Disables the cross-region level-2 backup feature.

30 to 7300: The retention period of cross-region level-2 backups, in days.

-1: Cross-region level-2 backups are permanently retained.

* When you create a cluster, the default value is 0, which disables the cross-region level-2 backup feature.

- After you enable advanced backup, this parameter is no longer effective. Use the `AdvancedDataPolicies` parameter instead

parameters.help_en:
The level of the backup policy. Valid values:

Normal: standard backup

Advanced: advanced backup

* This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

- Check the `AdvancedPolicyOption` parameter in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319231.html operation to determine whether the cluster supports advanced backup. If the cluster supports advanced backup, you can request this feature in [Advanced backup settings](~611727~~).

- After you enable advanced backup, you cannot switch back to standard backup
parameters.help_zh:
目标备份策略等级。取值范围如下：
Normal：常规备份
Advanced：高级备份
* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 您可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319231.html 接口的返回值 AdvancedPolicyOption 确认集群是否支持开启高级备份。若集群支持开启高级备份，可通过 [高级备份设置](~611727~~) 申请使用该功能。
* 高级备份开启后不支持回退至常规备份
parameters.name: backup_policy_level

fields.help_en:
The action type. Valid values:

CREATE: Create

UPDATE: Update

DELETE: Delete
fields.help_zh:
操作类型，取值如下：

CREATE：新增
UPDATE：修改
DELETE：删除
fields.name: action_type

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the backup policy is automatically generated by the system.

This value is automatically generated. You do not need to specify this parameter
fields.help_zh:
是否为系统自动生成的备份策略。

该参数值将自动生成，无需传递
fields.name: auto_created

fields.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

F: full backup

This parameter cannot be modified and is fixed to `F`
fields.help_zh:
备份类型，取值如下：

F：全量备份
该参数不支持修改，固定为F
fields.name: bak_type

fields.help_en: The destination region for the backup policy
fields.name: dest_region

fields.help_en:
The destination type for the backup policy. Valid values:

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: cross-region level-2 backup
fields.help_zh:
备份策略目标类型，取值如下：

level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份
fields.name: dest_type

fields.help_en:
The method to convert a level-1 backup to a level-2 backup. Valid values:

copy: Copy
fields.help_zh:
一级备份转二级备份方式，取值如下：

copy：复制
fields.name: dump_action

fields.help_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:

dayOfWeek: Weekly schedule

dayOfMonth: Monthly schedule

dayOfYear: Yearly schedule

backupInterval: Fixed interval schedule

This parameter is required only if `FilterType` is set to crontab
fields.help_zh:
调度类型，取值如下：

dayOfWeek：按周调度
dayOfMonth：按月调度
dayOfYear：按年调度
backupInterval：固定间隔调度

仅当FilterType为crontab时，需要该参数
fields.name: filter_key

fields.help_en:
The filter type for the advanced policy. Valid values:

crontab: Recurring schedule

event: Event-based schedule
fields.help_zh:
高级策略筛选类型，取值如下：

crontab：周期调度
event：事件调度
fields.name: filter_type

fields.help_en:
The retention policy for backups that are more than 24 hours old. Valid values:

true: Retains only the first backup set of the day.

false: Retains all backups
fields.help_zh:
24小时备份保留策略。
true：超过24小时仅保留当天第1个备份集
false：全保留
fields.name: only_preserve_one_each_day

fields.help_en:
The retention policy for hourly backups. Valid values:

true: Retains only the first backup set of each hour for backups that are more than one hour old.

false: Retains all backup sets.

This parameter cannot be modified and is fixed to `true`
fields.help_zh:
每小时备份保留策略。取值如下：
true：超过1小时只保留每小时内最早的备份集。
false：保留全部备份集。

该参数不支持修改，固定为true
fields.name: only_preserve_one_each_hour

fields.help_en: The ID of the backup policy. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319231.html operation to view the ID
fields.help_zh: 备份策略ID，可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319231.html 查看
fields.name: policy_id

fields.help_en:
The retention type for the backup set. Valid values:

never: Never expires.

delay: Expires after a specified number of days
fields.help_zh:
备份集保留周期类型，取值如下：

never：永不过期
delay：固定天数过期
fields.name: retention_type

fields.help_en: The number of days to retain the backup
fields.name: retention_value

fields.help_en: The source region for the backup policy
fields.name: src_region

fields.help_en:
The source type for the backup policy. Valid values:

db: database cluster

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: cross-region level-2 backup
fields.help_zh:
备份策略源类型，取值如下：

db：数据库集群
level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份
fields.name: src_type

parameters.help_en:
The advanced backup policies.

- This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

- This parameter is supported only for clusters for which `BackupPolicyLevel` is set to `Advanced`
parameters.help_zh:
高级备份策略。
* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 仅 BackupPolicyLevel 为 Advanced 的集群支持该参数
parameters.name: advanced_data_policies
